_comment: The Pip (lqe, LANA.cpp) build the client packages at <resources>/pip (electron-pip-supervisor.js), built by scripts/build-pip.sh on a matching computer with LANA.cpp's distribution contract. v3.1.0 = 8ee218c47371 (tag 2026-11-21): structured reasoning output (Qwen thinking contract, UTF-8 safe deltas), an integrated GPU used by default (LQE_ALLOW_IGPU=0 opts out), dec_backend in the computation identity, and a /props fix for embedding servers; no new flag or settings key the app passes. CI run 44937653949: windows-shipping, macos-shipping, linux-shipping and release-checklist green; windows-msvc-cpu (a /WX developer gate, not a shipping build) failed on C4456 shadowed names in tests/test_json_grammar.cpp only. The embedding match check passed for this build (LANA-AI embed-pin.json pip.verified_builds, 2026-11-21). scripts/build-pip.sh refuses a checkout whose tag resolves to any other commit (fetch with git fetch --tags --force). Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's sha256.

cmakeNotes.macos-x64: Not a LANA.cpp engine-release target at v3.1.0; flags come from its x64 release builds. LQE_DISTRIBUTION=ON and LQE_BUILD_TESTS=ON as in the linux-x64 and windows-x64 jobs of .github/workflows/engine-release.yml (GGML_NATIVE OFF, GGML_LLAMAFILE ON, static libraries are set by CMakeLists.txt). LQE_METAL=OFF: Intel Mac GPUs are not a LANA.cpp target, so this is the CPU backend like the x64 release builds; Accelerate stays on as in every Apple build. GGML_AVX2/FMA/F16C ON and AVX512 OFF: the x86-64-v3 baseline CMakeLists.txt pins for x64 distribution builds but applies only when NOT APPLE, so it is given here (every Mac that runs macOS 13.3 has AVX2). CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=x86_64 states what CMakeLists.txt would detect. The macOS floor is 13.3, forced by CMakeLists.txt for any LQE_DISTRIBUTION Apple build and the same as macos-arm64; Electron 44 runs on macOS 12, so an Intel Mac on macOS 12 gets the app without local Pip. Checked by scripts/verify-pip-macos-x64.js in place of LANA.cpp scripts/verify_release_artifact.py, which accepts only darwin-arm64.

macos-arm64.source: LANA.cpp CI run 44937653949 (head 8ee218c47371), job macos-shipping (-DLQE_DISTRIBUTION=ON -DLQE_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DLQE_METAL=ON, the macos-arm64 cmake contract above), artifact lqe-darwin-arm64 (GitHub digest sha256:132d2ad3...; kept in the private Cloudflare parts bucket lana-build-parts at macos-arm64/lqe-8ee218c47371/lqe-darwin-arm64 (uploaded 2026-11-23; the GitHub artifact expires 2026-12-05)). arm64 only, minos 13.3, links only /usr/lib and /System. CI builds are reproducible; a local build embeds its checkout path and gets a different sha256. Placed as build/pip/lqe; electron-builder signs it (mac.binaries).

vulkanLoader._comment: The Khronos Vulkan loader each platform's package ships in pip/vulkan-fallback, never beside lqe: lqe is built with LQE_VULKAN=ON and needs the loader to start at all, even on the processor, so a computer without one (a Windows VM or server, the basic display driver; a Linux machine without libvulkan1, found on an Azure Ubuntu 24.04 VM) could not start it. A copy beside lqe would win over the computer's own loader (Windows searches an application's folder before System32; Linux lqe has RUNPATH $ORIGIN), so electron-pip-supervisor.js runs lqe --version as it is and only when the loader is missing runs it again with this folder first on PATH (Windows) or LD_LIBRARY_PATH (Linux), then starts the servers with that environment. windows-x64: LunarG Vulkan Runtime components 1.3.296.0, the newest runtime archive LunarG publishes (approved 2026-11-12). linux-x64: the loader from the LunarG Linux SDK 1.4.350.0, the tarball LANA.cpp's CI pins (scripts/install_vulkan_sdk_linux.sh), shipped as libvulkan.so.1 (its SONAME); it needs glibc 2.34 or later. scripts/fetch-vulkan-loader.js takes each at build time only, checks the archive against the sha256 LunarG publishes (sha256Source) and the file against sha256; the app never downloads it.
